BiblicalUsage: To sprout is the first green of creation, when God said let the earth bring forth grass, and it did. Joel promises that the pastures will spring and the trees will bear their fruit when the locust years are over. Sprouting is the earth's yes to God's word.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sprout is the picture of resurrection in miniature: life comes up where only dry ground was.
